title: Jet64 cart.toml (schema 1)
description: The author-owned package manifest at a cart's root (docs/cart_exchange/cart_exchange.md §5.2). Documentation of the contract the jcx_validator crate enforces — the crate is authoritative. By design there is no build, command, script, url, flags, or hook field, and unknown keys are rejected: a field that would smuggle behaviour cannot be written down.

id.description: Permanent reverse-DNS-style identity, e.g. io.github.mira.space-hauler. Lowercase ASCII letters, digits, dots, hyphens; 3–128 bytes; at least two dot-separated segments, each starting and ending alphanumeric. Never recycled.

jet64_api.description: Minimum JET64_API_GENERATION the cart requires (E9) — a single monotone integer, never below the generation (api_generations.toml) of an API name the cart's source uses.

license.description: One SPDX id from the registry allowlist (§6.4), or several joined by ' OR '.

include.description: Narrows the release surface (applied by pruning after extraction). '/'-separated patterns: '**' spans directories, '*' matches within a segment, '?' one character. Relative only; no '.', '..', or empty segments. cart.toml is always implicitly included.

network.description: Whether the cart has network reach — dialling out (jet_net.h / jet_http.h / jet_ws.h) or answering (jet_http_serve.h). CI verifies this against the include tree in both directions; the declaration informs review and the INFO screen, and grants nothing.

clipboard.description: Whether the cart can read and write the player's clipboard (jet_clipboard.h) — only ever on the player's own copy and paste keys. CI verifies this against the include tree in both directions; the declaration informs review and the INFO screen, and grants nothing.
